mapper.select:
select * from (
select count(*) AS new_user_count from b_user where type = '社会客户' and flag != -1 and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) new_user, (
select count(*) AS new_consulting_count from wf_form where flag != -1 and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) consulting, (
select count(*) AS new_complain_count from w_complain where flag != -1 and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) complain, (
select count(*) AS new_contract_count from sc_service_contract where flag != -1 and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) new_contract, (
select count(*) as sent_num from wf_form wf join b_organization org on org.organization_id = wf.current_org_id where wf.flag = 1 and org.level != 1 and wf.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) sent_order, (
select count(*) as sign_num from wf_form wf join b_organization org on org.organization_id = wf.current_org_id where wf.form_id = any( select form_id from sc_service_contract where flag = 1 ) and wf.flag = 1 and org.level != 1 and wf.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) sign_contract, (
select count(*) as terminate_num from wf_form wf join b_organization org on org.organization_id = wf.current_org_id where wf.flag = 1 and wf.status = '已终止' and org.level != 1 and wf.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) terminate_order, (
select count(*) as processing_num from wf_form wf join b_organization org on org.organization_id = wf.current_org_id where wf.form_id not in ( select form_id from sc_service_contract where flag = 1 ) and wf.flag = 1 and wf.status != '已终止' and org.level != 1 and wf.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} ) processing_order

select *, ROUND(order_num / active_user_num * 100, 2) AS active_user_trans_rate, ROUND(contract_num / order_num * 100, 2) AS order_trans_rate from (
select count(*) AS active_user_num from b_user user left join r_user_role rur on rur.user_id = user.user_id left join l_user_token token on token.user_id = user.user_id where token.modify_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and rur.role_id = 5 ) active_user, (
select count(*) AS order_num from b_user user left join r_user_role rur on rur.user_id = user.user_id left join l_user_token token on token.user_id = user.user_id where token.modify_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and rur.role_id = 5 and user.user_id = any(select create_user_id from wf_form) ) `order`, (
select count(*) AS contract_num from b_user user left join r_user_role rur on rur.user_id = user.user_id left join l_user_token token on token.user_id = user.user_id where token.modify_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and rur.role_id = 5 and user.user_id = any( select create_user_id from wf_form where form_id = any(select form_id from sc_service_contract) ) ) contract

select star_list.star, count(satisfaction) as ent_num, count(satisfaction) * 100 / ( select count(*) as num from sc_contract_evaluate where satisfaction > 0 ) as rate from (select 1 as star union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5) star_list left join sc_contract_evaluate sce on sce.satisfaction = star_list.star group by star_list.star

select ( 1 * count(if(satisfaction = 1, 1, null)) + 2 * count(if(satisfaction = 2, 1, null)) + 3 * count(if(satisfaction = 3, 1, null)) + 4 * count(if(satisfaction = 4, 1, null)) + 5 * count(if(satisfaction = 5, 1, null)) ) / count(if(satisfaction > 0, 1, null)) as average from sc_contract_evaluate

select count(if(subject LIKE '%进度慢%', 1, null)) as slow_num, count(if(subject LIKE '%质量差%', 1, null)) as bad_quality_num, count(if(subject LIKE '%态度恶劣%', 1, null)) as bad_attitude, count(*) as total from w_complain where flag = 1 and create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select complain.organization_id as organization_id, ifnull(org.name, '无所属单位') as company_name, count(*) as num from w_complain complain left join b_organization org on org.organization_id = complain.organization_id where complain.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by complain.organization_id order by num desc
